text:
alex: Free pickup — pair of 27" monitors (vertical setup) + 3-arm VESA mount. No cables, but both work perfectly. Moving next week so need them gone by Thu. SOMA pickup. DM if you want them :raised_hands:

mira: Specs? resolution/refresh? any dead pixels?

alex: Dell U2723QE (IPS) 4K-ish? actually 2.5k, 60Hz. No dead pixels, very minor stand scuff. Mount is Ergotron LX triple-head style (heavy).

sam: Can you split? I only need one monitor.

alex: Prefer to keep as a set w/ mount since it's mounted vertically. If someone really needs 1 I can split for $40.

jordan: would you consider a trade? I have a like-new Kryptonite New-U U-lock + rack cable (NYC commuter special).

alex: Hmm maybe. Is it hardened shackle? pics?

jordan: yup, hardened, 12mm. here — https://imgur.com/example (photo). I can pick up Tue evening.

mira: If jordan flakes i'll take one for the $40 split.

ops-bot: Reminder: Please don’t leave items in commons spaces overnight. Use the mailroom for drops or coordinate pickup times.

alex: Good point — will meet at 6pm Tuesday by 3rd & Howard. Jordan you cool with that?

jordan: Yep 6pm works. I’ll bring cash + the lock.

sam: glhf :thumbsup:

alex: Claimed by jordan. If anything changes I’ll post here. Thanks y’all! :pray:
